name: sharpps-mcp
description: Connect any AI agent to SharpPS Replayr over MCP: write Playwright test scripts, run them on the Replayr runner, and read Jam-like reports (steps, console, network, video, trace).

interface.shortDescription: Write, run and review Playwright tests on SharpPS Replayr over MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect any AI agent to SharpPS Replayr over MCP: write Playwright test scripts, run them on the Replayr runner, and read Jam-like reports (steps, console, network, video, trace). Sign in with OAuth when the agent asks, or use an API token.
